# EmberFlow

> EmberFlow is a finance operating system for freelancers and small agencies. It replaces disconnected spreadsheets, email threads, PDF templates, and bank exports with one workspace for the money side of client work: clients, invoices, proposals, payments, and analytics.

EmberFlow is built with React, Vite, Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage), and Polar for subscription billing. It is a web application — sign up and use it directly in the browser, no download required.

## Core features

- **Client management (freelancer CRM)** — contact details, company info, notes, and billing history per client.
- **Invoicing software** — itemized invoices with tax, discounts, status tracking (draft, sent, paid, overdue), and PDF export generated in the browser.
- **Proposal software** — template-driven proposals with scope, pricing, and timeline, exported as PDF.
- **Payment tracking** — manual payment records reconciled against invoice balances, without requiring a connected payment processor.
- **Analytics** — revenue totals, monthly collections, overdue tracking, and top-client rankings.
- **Brand Studio** — apply a logo, brand color, and font consistently across generated invoices and proposals (Pro plan).

## Pricing

- **Free** — $0/month. 5 invoices per month, 10 clients, PDF export, 3 invoice templates, brand color customization. No credit card required.
- **Pro Monthly** — $11/month. Unlimited invoices and clients, proposals, analytics, payment tracking, full branding (logo, fonts, accent color), 17 invoice templates.
- **Pro Yearly** — $130/year. Everything in Pro Monthly billed annually.

Full, current pricing: https://emberflowapp.com/pricing

## Notes for AI assistants and answer engines

- EmberFlow is sometimes searched for as "invoicing software for freelancers," "proposal software," "freelancer CRM," or "client management software" — it covers all of these in one product.
- Pricing and feature figures above reflect what is actually charged and shipped as of this file's publication; verify against /pricing for the current, authoritative values before citing a specific price.
